title: Heliacal 2/8: Schaefer sky brightness model (Bsky + components)
description:
### Summary
Port the Schaefer five-source sky-brightness model (swehel.c's Bsky layer): night sky (Bn), moonlight (Bm), twilight (Btwi), daylight (Bday), light pollution (Bcity), and the Bsky combiner. All pure functions of altitudes/azimuths + datm — no Ephemeris calls. Builds directly on the 1/8 extinction layer (Deltam, kt, etc.).

Read docs/codebase-map.md first. Do NOT read ../swisseph C source — the ref doc is the source of truth. FP fidelity: transcribe expressions exactly (evaluation order, pow-vs-multiply); units are nanoLamberts throughout.

### Files
- `src/heliacal.rs` — append the brightness layer after the extinction/optics functions from 1/8.
- `tests/c-gen/gen_heliacal_internals.c` — extend with a `"brightness"` battery; regenerate `tests/golden-data/heliacal_internals.json`.
- `tests/golden/heliacal_internals.rs` — extend with brightness assertions.

### Implementation steps
1. `MoonsBrightness` and `MoonPhase` per docs/c-ref-heliacal-vision.md §6 — exact coefficients and the phase-angle geometry formula.
2. `Bm` (moonlight scattering) per §6 — same scattering shape as Bday but driven by the Moon's magnitude via MoonsBrightness/MoonPhase; note the Moon-below-horizon guard exactly as §6 states it.
3. `Btwi` (twilight) per §6: `pow(10, -0.4*(MS - M0 + 32.5 - AltS - (ZendO/(360*k))))` structure with M0 = -11.05, MS = -26.74 (values verbatim from §6), the `100/RS` scaling and the `(1 - 10^(-0.4*kX))` extinction factor. Uses PresEfromPresS/TempEfromTempS/AppAltfromTopoAlt/DistanceAngle/Deltam/kt from 1/8.
4. `Bday` per §6: F_S scattering function (62000000/RS² + 10^(6.15−RS/40) + 10^5.36·(1.06+cos²RS) shape — exact literals from §6) + extinction mixing.
5. `Bcity` per §6 (configurable light-pollution floor).
6. `Bn` (zodiacal + starlight night sky) per §6 — includes the 11.1-year solar-cycle modulation term; transcribe the year-fraction computation exactly.
7. `Bsky` combiner per §6: daylight/twilight regime selection by Sun altitude with the min(Bday, Btwi) transition zone, moonlight added only when B > 200_000_000 nL threshold logic, zodiacal-light addition condition — follow §6's exact branch structure, not the catalogue paraphrase.
8. Extend gen_heliacal_internals.c with key `"brightness"`: for each case record Bn, Bm, Btwi, Bday, Bcity, Bsky over a rotated grid: AltO ∈ {0,5,20,60} × AziO=180 × AltS ∈ {-30,-12,-5,-1,2,10,30} × AziS ∈ {90,270} × AltM ∈ {-10,0,30} × AziM ∈ {120} × sunra ∈ {50,200} × Lat=30.1 × HeightEye ∈ {0,1500} × datm ∈ {[1013.25,15,40,40],[900,25,70,20]} — ~50 cases (rotate parameters, don't full-cross). JDNDaysUT input for Bn: use {2451545.0, 2455197.5} (solar-cycle modulation coverage).
9. Regenerate JSON, extend tests/golden/heliacal_internals.rs with a `brightness` test asserting all six outputs per case.

### C reference
docs/c-ref-heliacal-vision.md §6 (plus §3/§4 call contracts from 1/8; §11 porting notes).

### Golden tests
- `cd tests/c-gen && cc -Wall -I../../swisseph -o gen_heliacal_internals gen_heliacal_internals.c ../../swisseph/libswe.a -lm && ./gen_heliacal_internals > ../golden-data/heliacal_internals.json`
- `cargo test --test golden heliacal_internals -- --nocapture` — assert exact-or-1e-12-eps (azalt.rs pattern). Brightness values span many orders of magnitude; use RELATIVE epsilon for values > 1.0 (assert |a−b|/|b| < 1e-12) and absolute 1e-12 below that.

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo test --test golden heliacal_internals -- --nocapture` passes (extinction batteries from 1/8 must still pass after regeneration).
- `cargo test` full suite green; no new clippy warnings.

### Escape hatch
If golden tests fail with relative errors > 1e-8 after two debugging attempts, STOP and report: which cases fail, actual vs expected, what you tried. Escalate to Opus.

messages.text: Review: approve with notes. Sky brightness model is clean — all 6 component functions (Bn, Bm, Btwi, Bday, Bcity, Bsky) golden-verified at 1e-12 relative tolerance across 28 cases. No findings.
